description: This file contains utility functions for validating and deriving usernames during user signup and team interactions, including checks against existing users and organization/team contexts.

methods.name: getUsernameForOrgMember
methods.description: Derives a username for an organization member, primarily from email during signup, or returns the provided username if not signup.

methods.name: validateAndGetCorrectedUsernameAndEmail
methods.description: Validates and possibly corrects username and email, checking for existing users and organization context.

methods.name: validateAndGetCorrectedUsernameInTeam
methods.description: Validates and corrects username within a team or organization context, handling team-specific logic.
